name: owners-table-v1
description: The owner's table: the ten precons the owner's group plays (DESIGN.md section 29: seven identified from photographs of the deck boxes on 2026-11-12, each commander checked against its card image and Forge's deck file, and three named as popular; Blight Curse, Veloci-Ramp-Tor, Mutant Menace and Squirreled Away are also the frozen benchmark pod). A league of these decks alone, and the pool a playtest of one of the owner's own lists draws its opponents from (runner/ab.py --deck-file ... --pool runner/leagues/owners-table-v1.json --opponent-playbooks): a deck that has a shipped playbook (playbook/precons/<id>.json) is seated under it, the others under stock Forge AI, so what this table is depends on the day; DESIGN.md section 30 and playbook/bots.json say which decks have one. If this list ever changes, that is a new league with a new name.
schedule: runner/league.py: ten decks are two tables a round with two byes that rotate through the list. A cycle is four rounds, eight games; every deck that is not sitting out sits in every seat once a cycle. 63 cycles = 504 games, about 200 per deck.
checked: The ten decks are league-v1 decks (runner/precon-league.json): same files, same checks.

decks.name: Squirreled Away
